_comment: Canonical SSE event wire envelope shapes. SessionEventWire routes events to a specific web or CLI session. BackgroundEventWire routes events to a user without session binding. Both wrap an SSE event body with type and data.

sse_event_body._description: Inner event body shared by both wire envelopes. Contains the event type string and a data payload object.

data.description: Event payload as a JSON object

session_event_wire._description: SSE envelope routing an event to a specific web or CLI session. Serialized from SessionEventWire (protocol/python/g8e/models/events.py). Excludes null fields on the wire.

web_session_id.description: Web session ID for routing. Exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id is set.

cli_session_id.description: CLI session ID for routing. Exactly one of web_session_id or cli_session_id is set.

event.description: SSE event body. Conforms to sse_event_body shape above.

background_event_wire._description: SSE envelope routing a background event to a user without session binding. Serialized from BackgroundEventWire (protocol/python/g8e/models/events.py).

event.description: SSE event body. Conforms to sse_event_body shape above.
